svg.aria-label: Gowtham M S, Java and Spring Boot backend engineer. Animated diagram of SkillProof: a candidate request flows through Next.js and Spring Boot to a FastAPI AI service, a Docker sandbox and MySQL, ending in an HMAC-signed badge, while an attacker packet is blocked. Rotating attack and defense pairs: generic AI answers are countered by repo-grounded questions, pasting by integrity telemetry, hostile code by a network-less read-only sandbox, forged badges by HMAC-SHA256.
